The issue you are encountering is caused by the Monaco Editor environment accumulating configuration settings and type definitions when switching between frameworks. Specifically:

1.  **React Mode Error**: `This JSX tag requires the module path 'solid-js/jsx-runtime' to exist...`
    *   This happens because when you switch from Solid to React, the `jsxImportSource: 'solid-js'` setting from Solid persists in the compiler options.
2.  **Solid Mode Error**: `Cannot find module 'solid-js'...`
    *   This happens because the `solid-js` type definitions are not being added to the editor environment, unlike React which had some basic types defined.

I have updated `Editor.tsx` to fix these issues by:
1.  **Cleaning Compiler Options**: Instead of merging new options with old ones (which causes pollution), I now reset the compiler options to a clean base state every time the framework changes.
2.  **Managing Type Definitions**: I implemented a cleanup mechanism using `extraLibsRef` to dispose of framework-specific type definitions (like React types) when switching away from them.
3.  **Adding Solid Types**: I added basic type definitions for `solid-js`, `solid-js/web`, and `solid-js/html` so the editor can recognize them.

You should now be able to switch between React and Solid without seeing these cross-contamination errors.

**Modified file:** `Editor.tsx`

  "textEditContent": "\nexport function generateVueScript(serializedFiles: string) {\n  return &#96;\n    &lt;script&gt;\n      const { loadModule } = window['vue3-sfc-loader'];\n      \n      let app = null;\n      \n      // Store files globally so they can be updated\n      window.__FILES__ = ${serializedFiles};\n\n      async function update(files) {\n        if (files) {\n          window.__FILES__ = files;\n        }\n        \n        if (app) {\n          app.unmount();\n          document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = '';\n        }\n\n        const options = {\n          moduleCache: {\n            vue: Vue\n          },\n          async getFile(url) {\n            const content = window.__FILES__[url.replace(/^\\\\.\\\\//, '')];\n            if (!content) throw new Error('File not found: ' + url);\n            return content;\n          },\n          addStyle(textContent) {\n            const style = document.createElement('style');\n            style.textContent = textContent;\n            style.dataset.generated = 'true';\n            const ref = document.head.getElementsByTagName('style')[0] || null;\n            document.head.insertBefore(style, ref);\n          },\n        }\n        \n        // Clean up old styles\n        document.querySelectorAll('style[data-generated]').forEach(el =&gt; el.remove());\n\n        app = Vue.createApp(Vue.defineAsyncComponent(() =&gt; loadModule('./App.vue', options)));\n        app.mount('#app');\n      }\n\n      // Initial load\n      update();\n\n      // Listen for updates\n      window.addEventListener('message', (e) =&gt; {\n        if (e.data.type === 'UPDATE_FILES') {\n          update(e.data.files);\n        }\n      });\n    &lt;/script&gt;&#96;\n}\n",
